responsibility: Edits and visualizes contracts, knowledge records, unknowns, impact paths, compatibility, baselines, readiness and evidence through the same core the agents use.
owns: Schema-driven editing controls, the local undo history and the local import comparison point.
boundary: No business validation of its own and no independently authoritative seal or acceptance state.
The local undo and import comparison point is never an accepted engineering baseline.
Persistent saves apply the shared expected-revision rule.

Connected to a workspace, it reads and acts only through the browser host, never the server's disk; disconnected, it shows the last content as a snapshot, disables connected actions and keeps imported evidence untrusted.
